$comment: Local recognisers. Runtime source and model revisions are pinned independently because the model repositories do not contain Marvi's LiveKit adapter. Measured on 2 September 2026 against docs/evals/stt-candidates: parakeet-tdt leads on accuracy and throughput, nemotron leads on responsiveness by 1.8 seconds.

engines.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B
engines.description: Most accurate and the fastest to finish. Waits about three seconds before its first partial.

engines.name: Nemotron 3.5 Streaming 0.6B
engines.description: First words about 1.8 seconds sooner, for roughly four points more word error.
